name: scenova
description: Turn stories into continuity-safe Three.js and Remotion film projects.

interface.longDescription: Scenova plans a story, preserves character and location continuity, generates a reusable Three.js and Remotion project, prepares dialogue and sound, and renders an editable final film.
defaultPrompt: Turn my story into a 60-second animated film.
Continue this film with the same characters.
Revise scene 3 and render the final video.
